name: SEN1-2: Co-registered Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 Satellite Image Pairs
description: SEN1-2 is a dataset comprising 282,384 co-registered pairs of synthetic aperture radar (SAR, Sentinel-1) and optical (Sentinel-2) satellite image patches collected from around the world across all meteorological seasons. Created by the Technical University of Munich (TUM), each patch is 256x256 pixels at 10m ground resolution, specifically curated to train and evaluate deep neural networks for SAR-optical data fusion, SAR-to-optical image translation, and cloud-robust Earth observation.
